headline: Spain approves new rules on water and energy in data centers despite sector criticism
summary: The Spanish government approved new rules on water and energy use for data centres, which it says aim to make facilities built in Spain among the most efficient and sustainable. The data centre sector has criticised the measures.
why: Data centres are major consumers of power and water, and regulatory limits on them affect the investment plans of operators and cloud providers.
original_headline: España aprueba nuevas normas sobre agua y energía en centros de datos pese a críticas del sector
